read_sections.body_en:
Elena, 38, is preparing a trial to reduce incorrect printouts at the BHS. The team needs an agreement and a measure of correct, timely materials.

Elena proposes checking the approved handout before each print run. She prepares the checklist, the midwife confirms the version, and after two weeks they review incorrect printouts and any delayed sessions. Record session counts to compare similar workloads. Share results and revise the process if quality suffers. Agree on the change rather than issuing a new rule to everyone without discussion.
read_sections.body_fil:
Si Elena, 38, ay naghahanda ng trial upang bawasan ang maling printout sa BHS. Kailangan ang kasunduan ng team at sukatan ng tama at napapanahong materyal.

Mungkahi ni Elena: i-check ang approved handout bago bawat print run. Siya ang maghahanda ng checklist, ang midwife ang kukumpirma sa bersyon, at susuriin nila makalipas ang dalawang linggo ang bilang ng maling printout at kung may naantalang session. Itala ang bilang ng sessions upang makumpara ang magkatulad na trabaho. Ibahagi ang resulta sa kasama at baguhin ang proseso kung may epekto sa kalidad. Ang pagbabago ay kailangang napagkasunduan, hindi basta bagong utos sa lahat.

read_sections.body_en: Describe waste without blame: “There are two versions in the drawer, which causes reprinting.” Present the proposal, responsibilities and review date. read_sections.body_fil: Sabihin ang napansing aksaya nang walang paninisi: “May dalawang bersyon sa drawer kaya may nauulit na print.” Ilahad ang mungkahi, sino ang may trabaho at kailan rerepasuhin. read_sections.body_en: One week has five teaching sessions and the next has ten. Total paper use can rise even when the process improves. Compare correct materials and reprints per session or per 100 pages, alongside complaints or delays. Do not claim savings from a raw total alone. Distinguish workload changes from process changes.
read_sections.body_fil: Isang linggo ay 5 ang teaching sessions; sa susunod ay 10. Maaaring dumami ang nagamit na papel kahit mas mahusay ang proseso. Ihambing ang wastong materyal at reprints kada session o bawat 100 pahina, kasama ang anumang reklamo o delay. Huwag mag-claim ng savings mula sa raw total lamang. read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang patas na paghahambing ay isinasaalang-alang ang dami ng trabahong ginawa.

read_sections.body_en: When Elena is absent, a colleague should still be able to use the teaching kit and checklist. Keep a short routine at the work area, orient new colleagues and identify who receives stock-gap reports. During review, remove unhelpful steps and preserve necessary safeguards. A sustainable system does not depend on one diligent person’s memory.
read_sections.body_fil: Kapag wala si Elena, dapat magamit pa rin ng kapalit ang teaching kit at checklist. Ilagay ang maikling routine sa lugar ng trabaho, ituro sa bagong kasama at tukuyin kung kanino iuulat ang stock gap. Sa review, alisin ang hakbang na walang silbi at panatilihin ang proteksyong kailangan. Ang sustainable na sistema ay hindi umaasa sa alaala ng iisang masipag na tao.

## [purpose] Layunin

Magmungkahi ng maliit na trial na may owner at review date, at ihambing ang resource use sa magkatulad na workload kasama ang kalidad ng serbisyo.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

60 minuto para sa pagsasanay na pinamumunuan ng facilitator. Bahagi ito ng 3 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Ihanda ang dalawang halimbawang 100-page tally at blank trial card. Tiyakin kung sino ang may authority sa approved version at trial.

## [opening] Pambungad

Kalahati ang nabawas sa papel dahil kalahati rin ang nakanselang sessions. Ano ang masasabi?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Sa comparison check, bumaba ang reprint ng 15 bawat 100 pahina; tiyaking maihahambing ang workload at tama pa rin ang materyal. Hindi patunay ang rate na ito na 75% ang nabawas sa gastos.

Sa communication check, tugunan ang kawalan ng internet sa pamamagitan ng kontroladong papel na master, pagtitiyak sa bersyon at paghingi ng puna ng kasama. Huwag gumamit ng hindi aprubadong lumang kopya.

Ang unang sagot ay isinasaalang-alang ang workload at kalidad. Ang kabuuang bill o papel lamang ay maaaring bumaba dahil nawala ang serbisyo, hindi dahil bumuti ang proseso.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Ipinapahayag na tagumpay ang mas mababang total kahit bumaba o nakansela ang serbisyo. Ang mas mababang konsumo ay tagumpay lamang kung naibibigay pa rin ang tama at ligtas na serbisyo.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Punan ang trial card: problema, pagbabago, owner, baseline, sukatan ng kalidad, review date. Gamitin ang 20/100 at 5/100 para sa patas na paghahambing. Magpares: isa ang kasamahang walang internet; ipaliwanag ang controlled paper master at handover. Kung mag-isa, isulat ang magiging routine ng kapalit. Sa team meeting, ipasuri ang trial bago simulan at magtakda ng review.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

Comparison check: 1. Bawas na 15 reprint bawat 100 pahina; suriin ang workload at tamang materyal.

Communication check: 2. Maghanda ng kontroladong papel na master, tiyakin ang bersyon at hingin ang puna.

1. Hindi pa patunay ng improvement; ihambing ang gamit bawat session at naibigay na serbisyo.

Ang unang sagot ay isinasaalang-alang ang workload at kalidad. Ang kabuuang bill o papel lamang ay maaaring bumaba dahil nawala ang serbisyo, hindi dahil bumuti ang proseso.

## [observe] Obserbahan

May owner, baseline, quality measure at review date ang trial; tama ang 20% tungong 5% na paghahambing; isinasaalang-alang ang workload at handover.

Kaya na: May owner, baseline, quality measure at review date ang trial; tama ang 20% tungong 5% na paghahambing; isinasaalang-alang ang workload at handover. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: Kumpleto ang plano ngunit raw total lang ang comparison; ipagamit ang bawat session o bawat 100 pahina.

Hindi pa: Ipinapahayag na tagumpay ang mas mababang total kahit bumaba o nakansela ang serbisyo.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

Kumpleto ang plano ngunit raw total lang ang comparison; ipagamit ang bawat session o bawat 100 pahina. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 19, 22; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 14, 30; TESDA BHS NC II Revision 01 (2019), unit 400311217: PDF 33, 34, 35. Instructional expansion ito ng ikasiyam na competency, hindi hiwalay na manual chapter. Ang draft crosswalk sa TESDA 400311217 ay nasa review report; kailangan pa ng assessor review at lokal na work procedures. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

Propose a small trial with an owner and review date, and compare resource use at comparable workloads alongside service quality.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

60 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 3 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Prepare the two fictional 100-page tallies and a blank trial card. Confirm authority for the approved version and trial.

## [opening] Opening

Paper use halved because half the sessions were canceled. What can be concluded?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

For the comparison check, reprints fell by 15 per 100 pages; confirm that workload and correct materials remained comparable. This rate does not prove a 75% reduction in cost.

For the communication check, address the no-internet barrier with a controlled paper master, version verification and colleague feedback. Do not substitute an unapproved old copy.

The first response accounts for workload and quality. Total bills or paper can fall because service was lost, not because the process improved.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Declares lower totals a success despite reduced or canceled services. Lower consumption is a success only when correct, safe service is still delivered.

## [practice] Practice activity

Fill a trial card: problem, change, owner, baseline, quality measure, review date. Use 20/100 and 5/100 for a fair comparison. In pairs, one colleague has no internet; explain the controlled paper master and handover. Alone, write the replacement colleague’s routine. Ask the team to review the trial before starting and set a review date.

## [answer-key] Answer key

Comparison check: 1. Fifteen fewer reprints per 100 pages; check comparable workload and correct materials.

Communication check: 2. Prepare a controlled paper master, verify its version and ask for feedback.

1. This does not yet show improvement; compare use per session and services delivered.

The first response accounts for workload and quality. Total bills or paper can fall because service was lost, not because the process improved.

## [observe] Observe

Specifies owner, baseline, quality measure and review date; correctly compares 20% with 5%; accounts for workload and handover.

Ready: Specifies owner, baseline, quality measure and review date; correctly compares 20% with 5%; accounts for workload and handover. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Completes the plan but compares raw totals only; prompt for per-session or per-100-page measures.

Not yet: Declares lower totals a success despite reduced or canceled services.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Completes the plan but compares raw totals only; prompt for per-session or per-100-page measures. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 19, 22; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 14, 30; TESDA BHS NC II Revision 01 (2019), unit 400311217: PDF 33, 34, 35. This expands the ninth competency rather than a standalone manual chapter. The draft TESDA 400311217 crosswalk is in the review report; assessor review and local work procedures remain pending. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

read_sections.body_en: BHW Elena, 38, is preparing health teaching at the BHS. A tap leaks, incorrect handouts are repeatedly printed, and missing supplies are bought again. She does not immediately conclude that the budget is too small. She records where water, paper, electricity and time are being wasted. Effective workplace practice delivers needed services while reducing wasted resources.
read_sections.body_fil: Si BHW Elena, 38 anyos, ay naghahanda ng health teaching sa BHS. May tumutulong gripo, paulit-ulit na maling printout at mga gamit na hindi makita kaya bumibili ulit. Hindi agad “kulang ang budget” ang konklusyon niya. Itinala niya kung saan nauubos ang tubig, papel, kuryente at oras. ## [purpose] Layunin

Sa halimbawang BHS, itala ang tatlong pag-aaksaya, ang ebidensya at isang ligtas na routine na makababawas sa paghahanap o dobleng pag-order.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

60 minuto para sa pagsasanay na pinamumunuan ng facilitator. Bahagi ito ng 3 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Ihanda ang kunwaring kit, stock count at dalawang bersyon ng handout. Tiyakin kung alin ang aprubado.

## [opening] Pambungad

Hindi makita ang handouts kaya may gustong mag-order ulit. Ano muna?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Sa inventory check, ihiwalay ang lumang handout, tiyakin ang aprubadong master at humingi ng kasalukuyang kopya. Masisira ang tamang impormasyon kung papalitan lang ang label o ipamamahagi ang luma.

Ang ikalawang sagot ay sinusuri ang tunay na pangangailangan at tamang materyal. Ang dobleng order ay maaaring pag-aaksaya; ang lumang handout ay maaaring maling bersyon.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Nag-oorder sa hula o ginagamit ang expired o maling materyal para lang makatipid. Magsimula sa nakitang pag-aaksaya at maayos na routine, hindi sa hula na kulang ang budget.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Gumawa ng audit na may resource, nakitang pag-aaksaya, ebidensya at ligtas na susunod na hakbang. Gamitin ang tatlong halimbawa ni Elena; huwag mag-imbento ng bill o dami. Ipakita sa kapareha kung paano ang label at stock count ay iiwas sa dobleng order. Kung mag-isa, sundan ang checklist gamit ang kunwaring teaching kit. Sa susunod na duty, obserbahan ang isang resource at talakayin ang findings sa supervisor.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

Inventory check: 3. Ihiwalay ang luma, tiyakin ang aprubadong master at humingi ng kasalukuyang kopya.

2. Suriin ang labeled storage, approved version at bilang ng stock.

Ang ikalawang sagot ay sinusuri ang tunay na pangangailangan at tamang materyal. Ang dobleng order ay maaaring pag-aaksaya; ang lumang handout ay maaaring maling bersyon.

## [observe] Obserbahan

May tatlong obserbasyong may kaugnay na resource at ebidensya; nagpapakita ng label, count at return routine; hindi ginagamit ang expired o maling bersyon.

Kaya na: May tatlong obserbasyong may kaugnay na resource at ebidensya; nagpapakita ng label, count at return routine; hindi ginagamit ang expired o maling bersyon. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: Nakikita ang waste ngunit walang ebidensya o routine owner; ipapunan ang audit row at ulitin.

Hindi pa: Nag-oorder sa hula o ginagamit ang expired o maling materyal para lang makatipid.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

Nakikita ang waste ngunit walang ebidensya o routine owner; ipapunan ang audit row at ulitin. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 19, 22; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 14, 30; TESDA BHS NC II Revision 01 (2019), unit 400311217: PDF 33, 34, 35. Instructional expansion ito ng ikasiyam na competency, hindi hiwalay na manual chapter. Ang draft crosswalk sa TESDA 400311217 ay nasa review report; kailangan pa ng assessor review at lokal na work procedures. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

In a sample BHS, record three sources of waste, their evidence and a safe routine that reduces searching or duplicate ordering.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

60 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 3 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Prepare a fictional kit, stock count and two handout versions. Identify the approved version.

## [opening] Opening

Handouts cannot be found, so someone wants to reorder. What first?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

For the inventory check, set aside outdated handouts, verify the approved master and request current copies. Relabeling or distributing an old version would sacrifice correct information.

The second response checks actual need and the correct material. Duplicate ordering may waste resources; an old handout may be the wrong version.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Orders from guesses or uses expired or incorrect material simply to save resources. Start with observed waste and a reliable routine, not an assumption that the budget is insufficient.

## [practice] Practice activity

Make an audit with resource, observed waste, evidence and a safe next step. Use Elena’s three examples; do not invent bills or quantities. Show a partner how labels and stock counts prevent duplicate orders. Alone, check a fictional teaching kit. At the next duty, observe one resource and discuss findings with the supervisor.

## [answer-key] Answer key

Inventory check: 3. Set aside the old copies, verify the approved master and request current copies.

2. Check labeled storage, approved version and stock count.

The second response checks actual need and the correct material. Duplicate ordering may waste resources; an old handout may be the wrong version.

## [observe] Observe

Records three observations with resources and evidence, demonstrates a label-count-return routine and does not use expired items or incorrect versions.

Ready: Records three observations with resources and evidence, demonstrates a label-count-return routine and does not use expired items or incorrect versions. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Identifies waste but gives no evidence or routine owner; complete the audit row and repeat.

Not yet: Orders from guesses or uses expired or incorrect material simply to save resources.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Identifies waste but gives no evidence or routine owner; complete the audit row and repeat. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 19, 22; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 14, 30; TESDA BHS NC II Revision 01 (2019), unit 400311217: PDF 33, 34, 35. This expands the ninth competency rather than a standalone manual chapter. The draft TESDA 400311217 crosswalk is in the review report; assessor review and local work procedures remain pending. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

read_sections.body_en:
Charlaine is a BHW in this fictional story. She wants to reduce waste while preserving safe, correct services. The BHS has a high bill and a vaccine refrigerator. The cause of the high consumption is not yet known.

“What is unnecessary, and what must stay?” she asks. Keep cold-chain equipment, required ventilation and other critical systems operating. Preserve handwashing water. Investigate only unnecessary lights under facility procedure; do not demonstrate switching off actual equipment.

If a leak is reported, record it and ask an authorized person to inspect it. Charlaine does not perform the repair. Authorization, repair completion and savings are not yet confirmed. In the next question, choose what is safe to investigate and explain the protection that must remain.
read_sections.body_fil:
Si Charlaine ay isang BHW sa kathang-isip na kuwentong ito. Gusto niyang bawasan ang aksaya nang hindi nababawasan ang ligtas at tamang serbisyo. Mataas ang bill ng BHS at may vaccine refrigerator. Hindi pa alam kung ano ang sanhi ng mataas na konsumo.

“Alin ang hindi kailangan, at alin ang dapat manatili?” tanong niya. Panatilihing gumagana ang cold-chain equipment, kinakailangang bentilasyon at ibang kritikal na sistema. Panatilihin ang tubig para sa paghuhugas ng kamay. Siyasatin lamang ang hindi kailangang ilaw ayon sa facility procedure; huwag mag-switch-off demonstration sa aktuwal na kagamitan.

Kung may iniulat na tagas, itala at ipasuri sa awtorisadong tao. Hindi si Charlaine ang magkukumpuni. Hindi pa kumpirmado ang pahintulot, pagkumpuni o matitipid. Sa susunod na tanong, piliin ang ligtas na siyasatin at ipaliwanag ang proteksyong kailangang manatili.

read_sections.body_en:
Someone suggests a durable health-teaching visual to Charlaine. It may reduce repeated disposable decorations if approved and suitable for its users. Preserve correct information and needed instructions, including a copy when the learner needs one.

An unnecessary nonclinical disposable differs from a clinical single-use item. Plastics reduction does not authorize reusing needles, lancets or other clinical single-use supplies. Follow local policy and proper segregation; do not invent cleaning or reuse methods.

“If I do not know the classification or policy, I will ask the supervisor first,” Charlaine says. Practice compares option cards only. No actual clinical item is used or cleaned. Approval of a new visual is not yet confirmed.
read_sections.body_fil:
May nagmungkahi kay Charlaine ng matibay na visual para sa health teaching. Maaaring mabawasan nito ang paulit-ulit na disposable decoration kung aprubado at angkop sa mga gagamit. Panatilihin ang tamang impormasyon at kailangang instruction, kabilang ang kopyang kailangan ng learner.

Iba ang hindi kailangang nonclinical disposable sa clinical single-use item. Hindi pahintulot ang pagbabawas ng plastics para muling gamitin ang karayom, lancet o iba pang clinical single-use supply. Sundin ang lokal na policy at tamang segregation; huwag mag-imbento ng paglilinis o pagre-reuse.

“Kung hindi ko alam ang uri o policy, magtatanong muna ako sa supervisor,” sabi ni Charlaine. Sa pagsasanay, option cards lamang ang ihahambing. Walang tunay na clinical item na gagamitin o lilinisin. Hindi pa kumpirmado ang pag-apruba sa isang bagong visual.

read_sections.body_en:
Before printing, Charlaine and her colleague check the handout date and version. A drawer copy is not automatically the approved master. Find the controlled master and confirm the current approved version with the supervisor under the document-control procedure.

Assemble dummy teaching materials together to reduce searching and repeated trips. Supplies may be delivered together on a planned safe route when authorized, but never delay urgent referral to save travel.

Productivity means quality, timely service with less waste and rework. The number of rushed clients does not prove good work. Organizing the kit is still a proposal; it does not prove measured time or financial savings.
read_sections.body_fil:
Bago mag-print, tinitingnan ni Charlaine at ng kasamahan ang petsa at bersyon ng handout. Ang nasa drawer ay hindi awtomatikong approved master. Hanapin ang controlled master at kumpirmahin sa supervisor ang kasalukuyang aprubadong bersyon ayon sa document-control procedure.

Ihanda nang magkakasama ang dummy teaching materials upang mabawasan ang paghahanap at pabalik-balik. Maaaring pagsamahin ang delivery sa planadong ligtas na ruta kung pinahihintulutan, ngunit huwag ipagpaliban ang urgent referral para makatipid sa biyahe.

Ang productivity ay dekalidad at napapanahong serbisyo na may mas kaunting aksaya at pag-uulit. Hindi patunay ng husay ang dami ng minadaling kliyente. Ang pag-aayos ng kit ay mungkahi pa lamang; hindi ito patunay ng nasukat na oras o pinansiyal na natipid.

read_sections.body_en:
On the fictional verification sheet, the drawer copy and incorrect printout are both version A. The controlled master is version B. The simulated supervisor confirms B as approved. These are dummy teaching sheets with no patient records.

There are two possible causes: an old drawer copy was copied, or the wrong file was selected before printing. Matching versions A are consistent with the first explanation but do not prove the drawer was used. Version A may also be on the computer. The person who printed has not yet been asked, and the selected file has not been inspected.

Charlaine records: the difference from the approved master is confirmed; the cause remains unconfirmed. Compare the drawer, printout and controlled master, then ask the person who printed and the supervisor. Do not blame someone or change the routine on a guess. Versions A and B are fictional inputs, not official DOH versions.

slides.narration_en:
Charlaine is a BHW in this fictional story. She wants to reduce waste while preserving safe, correct services. The BHS has a high bill and a vaccine refrigerator. The cause of the high consumption is not yet known.

“What is unnecessary, and what must stay?” she asks. Keep cold-chain equipment, required ventilation and other critical systems operating. Preserve handwashing water. Investigate only unnecessary lights under facility procedure; do not demonstrate switching off actual equipment.

If a leak is reported, record it and ask an authorized person to inspect it. Charlaine does not perform the repair. Authorization, repair completion and savings are not yet confirmed. In the next question, choose what is safe to investigate and explain the protection that must remain.

Si Charlaine ay isang BHW sa kathang-isip na kuwentong ito. Gusto niyang bawasan ang aksaya nang hindi nababawasan ang ligtas at tamang serbisyo. Mataas ang bill ng BHS at may vaccine refrigerator. Hindi pa alam kung ano ang sanhi ng mataas na konsumo.

“Alin ang hindi kailangan, at alin ang dapat manatili?” tanong niya. Panatilihing gumagana ang cold-chain equipment, kinakailangang bentilasyon at ibang kritikal na sistema. Panatilihin ang tubig para sa paghuhugas ng kamay. Siyasatin lamang ang hindi kailangang ilaw ayon sa facility procedure; huwag mag-switch-off demonstration sa aktuwal na kagamitan.

Kung may iniulat na tagas, itala at ipasuri sa awtorisadong tao. Hindi si Charlaine ang magkukumpuni. Hindi pa kumpirmado ang pahintulot, pagkumpuni o matitipid. Sa susunod na tanong, piliin ang ligtas na siyasatin at ipaliwanag ang proteksyong kailangang manatili.

slides.narration_en:
Someone suggests a durable health-teaching visual to Charlaine. It may reduce repeated disposable decorations if approved and suitable for its users. Preserve correct information and needed instructions, including a copy when the learner needs one.

An unnecessary nonclinical disposable differs from a clinical single-use item. Plastics reduction does not authorize reusing needles, lancets or other clinical single-use supplies. Follow local policy and proper segregation; do not invent cleaning or reuse methods.

“If I do not know the classification or policy, I will ask the supervisor first,” Charlaine says. Practice compares option cards only. No actual clinical item is used or cleaned. Approval of a new visual is not yet confirmed.
slides.narration_fil:
May nagmungkahi kay Charlaine ng matibay na visual para sa health teaching. Maaaring mabawasan nito ang paulit-ulit na disposable decoration kung aprubado at angkop sa mga gagamit. Panatilihin ang tamang impormasyon at kailangang instruction, kabilang ang kopyang kailangan ng learner.

Iba ang hindi kailangang nonclinical disposable sa clinical single-use item. Hindi pahintulot ang pagbabawas ng plastics para muling gamitin ang karayom, lancet o iba pang clinical single-use supply. Sundin ang lokal na policy at tamang segregation; huwag mag-imbento ng paglilinis o pagre-reuse.

“Kung hindi ko alam ang uri o policy, magtatanong muna ako sa supervisor,” sabi ni Charlaine. Sa pagsasanay, option cards lamang ang ihahambing. Walang tunay na clinical item na gagamitin o lilinisin. Hindi pa kumpirmado ang pag-apruba sa isang bagong visual.

Assemble dummy teaching materials together to reduce searching and repeated trips. Supplies may be delivered together on a planned safe route when authorized, but never delay urgent referral to save travel.

Productivity means quality, timely service with less waste and rework. The number of rushed clients does not prove good work. Organizing the kit is still a proposal; it does not prove measured time or financial savings.

private_notes.notes_fil:
## [purpose] Layunin at ebidensya

Pumili ng resource-saving action na nagpapanatili ng infection prevention, critical equipment at napapanahong serbisyo, at ipaliwanag ang tinanggihang opsyon. Kathang-isip na BHW si Charlaine; hindi DOH quotation ang adaptation. Produkto: isang proposal na may safeguard, rejection, verification at retry. Ang quiz, attendance at panonood ay hindi observed competence.

## [time-materials] Oras at materyales

5 opening + 12 modelling + 25 practice/feedback/retry + 10 safeguards debrief + 8 transfer = 60 minutes. Ang 60 + 60 + 60 = 180 ay module practice allocation. Hiwalay ang self-study audio at optional story; hindi ito TESDA certification.

Para sa 30 learner: sampung triad, BHW/kasamahan/observer. Ihanda ang bilingual A4 kit: option cards, version/cause sheet, safeguard checklist, proposal/retry record at one-page decision aid. Gumamit lamang ng dummy teaching sheets at kit; walang patient record, gamot, clinical item o aktuwal na utility work. Ibigay ang buong fictional inputs sa kit; hindi kailangang mag-imbento ang trainer.

## [prepare] Ihanda bago magsimula

Basahin ang anim na paired screens at parehong original checks. Suriin ang lokal na document-control, clinical single-use at facility procedures sa awtorisadong reviewer bago workplace transfer. Hindi pa kumpirmado ang policy approval sa kuwentong ito. Kung walang approved procedure, discussion at dummy rehearsal lamang.

I-print ang kit, basahin ang version A/B inputs at ihanda ang roster T1–T10, learner A/B/C. Trainer sample: round 1 T1-A, round 2 T2-B, round 3 T3-C. Sabihin nang maaga na ang ibang 27 ay hindi trainer-observed sa run na ito. Magtakda ng susunod na observation slot; huwag markahang passed ang peer record.

## [opening] Opening: 5 minuto

Sabihin: “Ano ang aksaya na puwedeng bawasan nang buo pa rin ang proteksyon?” Ipakita ang card na may high bill at vaccine refrigerator, walang equipment switching. Itanong: “Ano ang dapat manatili?” Inaasahan: cold chain, required ventilation at handwashing water. Sabihin: “Proposal ang gagawin natin, hindi repair o pagtanggal ng serbisyo.” Ipabasa o basahin nang malakas ang objective at original utilities check.

## [steps] Modelling: 12 minuto

Minuto 0–4: ihambing ang utilities cards. Sabihin: “Siyasatin ang hindi kailangang ilaw ayon sa procedure; hindi patayin ang refrigerator.” I-model ang unknown approval at savings.

Minuto 4–8: ilatag ang drawer A, printout A, controlled master B at supervisor confirmation B. Itanong: “Anong kumpirmado? Anong hindi pa?” Itala ang version mismatch. Ipakita ang dalawang sanhi: drawer copied versus wrong file selected. Parehong hindi pa proved; wala pang sagot ang nag-print. Kumpirmahin ang source bago routine change.

Minuto 8–12: i-model ang mahinang “Reusable para tipid.” Feedback: “Anong instruction ang mananatili? Anong single-use ang tatanggihan?” Retry: “Aprubadong teaching visual kung angkop, buo ang instruction; walang clinical reuse. Policy approval kailangan.” Ipakita ang proposal/retry record; huwag ipakita ang check ending bago sumagot.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot at produkto

Safe proposal: ipasuri/ipaayos ang iniulat na tagas sa awtorisadong tao habang buo ang handwashing water, o siyasatin ang aprubadong teaching visual kung angkop at buo ang accessible instruction. Rejection: handwashing restriction o clinical single-use reuse. Ang high bill ay hindi patunay na refrigerator ang problema.

Verification product: drawer A; printout A; master B; kunwaring supervisor confirms B. Kumpirmado ang mismatch. Hindi pa alam kung drawer o computer file ang sanhi. Susunod: ihambing ang copies/files at kausapin ang nag-print sa ilalim ng procedure. Walang sinasabing cost, measured savings, repair completion o actual approval.

Kumpletong record: napiling proposal; posibleng aksayang mabawasan; safeguard; rejected option at dahilan; approval/verification na kailangan; unang attempt; tiyak na feedback; observable retry; trainer-observation status.

## [misconception] Maling pagkaunawa at ligtas na paghinto

“Mas kaunting papel kahit mali” → itama ang approved version at kumpletong instruction. “Lahat ng plastic reusable” → paghiwalayin ang nonclinical teaching visual at clinical single-use. “Parehong A, kaya drawer ang sanhi” → tugma lamang, hindi proof. “High bill, patayin ang refrigerator” → protektahan ang cold chain.

Kung may actual shutdown, repair, clinical reuse o patient record na iminungkahi, sabihin: “Hinto. Option cards lamang; hindi natin aalisin ang kailangang proteksyon.” Itigil ang unsafe demonstration, ipaliwanag ang safeguard, at ipaulit sa dummy case. Hindi remedyo ang invented cleaning recipe. Ipa-review ang local procedure sa awtorisadong facility/infection-prevention reviewer.

## [practice] Practice, feedback at retry: 25 minuto

Tatlong anim-na-minutong rounds = 18 minuto, saka 7 minutong shared debrief. Sa bawat round: 2 context/setup + 2 attempt + 1 feedback + 1 retry = 6. Round 1 A ang BHW, B kasamahan, C observer; round 2 B/C/A; round 3 C/A/B.

Round 1: tagas versus handwashing restriction. Round 2: approved reusable teaching visual versus clinical single-use reuse. Round 3: version/cause sheet at paper-saving proposal. Sa bawat attempt itanong: “Ano ang pipiliin? Anong proteksyon ang mananatili? Bakit tinanggihan ang kabila? Anong hindi pa alam?” Observer records exact action/words, hindi impression.

Feedback: pangalanan ang isang kulang, halimbawa “Wala pa ang approval.” Retry: learner adds “Kumpirmahin muna sa supervisor; mungkahi pa lamang.” Trainer watches all four attempt/feedback/retry minutes for one sampled learner each round; remaining two minutes are setup/movement. Debrief: paghambingin ang mga unknowns, walang attendance-based passing.

## [answer-key] Answer key sa parehong checks

Utilities: index 0, unang opsyon. 1: siyasatin ang unnecessary lights under procedure habang gumagana ang refrigerator. 2: unsafe ang overnight refrigerator shutdown. 3: unsafe ang required-ventilation shutdown. Charlaine chooses safeguarded investigation, rejects both cuts and submits for authorized decision. Approval at savings unknown.

Check: index 2, ikatlong opsyon. 1: hindi tanggalin ang needed instructions. 2: hindi ubusin ang lumang bersyon nang walang approved-version verification. 3: siyasatin ang approved version at approved reusable visual kung angkop at buo ang accessible instruction. Charlaine submits the safeguarded proposal; walang claim ng measured savings, repair completion o observed competence.

Basahin ang lahat ng dahilan pagkatapos sumagot. Protektado ang tubig, single-use rules, critical equipment, ventilation at urgent referral. Ang quiz choices at prompt ay eksaktong original; huwag magdagdag ng bagong factual input sa tanong.

## [observe] Observation at debrief: 10 minuto

Trainer sample: T1-A round 1 minuto 2–6; T2-B round 2 minuto 8–12; T3-C round 3 minuto 14–18, relative sa practice start. Tatlong complete four-minute observations lamang; at least 27 learners remain not trainer-observed. Peer practice is not a pass.

Gamitin ang objective_index 0 indicator: ligtas na choice, evidence checking sa dalawang causes, safeguard at rejection, verification bago workplace action. Kaya na: walang prompt. Kailangan practice: ligtas ngunit kulang ang paliwanag; feedback at retry. Hindi pa: unsafe cut; safe stop at supported retry. Itala ang actual observed words/action at support; huwag gawing certification rule ang rubric.

Gumawa ng follow-up roster: T1-B/C, T2-A/C, T3-A/B at T4–T10 A/B/C = 27. Magbigay ng hiwalay na apat-na-minutong observation slot bawat learner, at setup/movement time; hindi ito kasya sa natitirang 10 minuto. Sa debrief itanong kung anong evidence at proteksyon ang mananatili.

## [support] Support at transfer: 8 minuto

Basahin ang cards nang malakas, gumamit ng malaking print at learner-selected language. Maaaring spoken answer na isusulat ng kasamahan; pareho ang objective. Scaffold: “Pipiliin ko ang __. Mananatili ang __. Tatanggihan ko ang __ dahil __. Kumpirmahin muna ang __.” Unti-unting alisin ang prompt sa retry at itala ang tulong.

Solo: isulat/sabihin ang parehong apat na linya, ihambing sa aid, itama at ulitin. Walang solo self-pass; mag-book ng trainer observation. Transfer prompt: “Sa susunod na duty, anong proposal at anong approved procedure ang iche-check mo muna?” I-record ang verifier at follow-up na hindi pa kumpirmado. Walang actual implementation habang walang authorization.

## [sources-review] Sources at hiwalay na review

Candidate sources: Facilitator PDF 19/printed 12 (3-hour sustainable competency), PDF 22/printed 15 (ibang 4-hour entrepreneurial competency), PDF 34/printed 27 (ibang 10-hour common competency); Manual PDF 14/printed 6 at PDF 30/printed 19; TESDA unit 400311217; WHO sustainability guidance. Manual at Guide ay magkaiba ang order ng 7S; huwag baguhin ang quotations o gawing iisang prescribed sequence.

Walang hiwalay na sustainable section sa original 78-slide Day 1 deck; huwag mag-imbento ng slide citation. Ang fictional case at A/B sheets ay adaptation, hindi source quotation. Tingnan ang exact source-audit receipt para sa na-inspect na originals at unresolved access. Hindi awtomatikong certification ang 60 minutong practice.

Mga hiwalay na estado: source audit; facility/infection-prevention review; actual model audio review; human listening; owner package approval. Pending ang local reviewer, human listening at owner approval; hindi pinapalitan ng model review ang mga ito.

## [purpose] Purpose and evidence

Choose a resource-saving action that preserves infection prevention, critical equipment and timely services, and explain the rejected option. Charlaine is a fictional BHW; the adaptation is not a DOH quotation. Product: a proposal with a safeguard, rejection, verification and retry. A quiz, attendance or watching the story is not observed competence.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

5 opening + 12 modelling + 25 practice/feedback/retry + 10 safeguards debrief + 8 transfer = 60 minutes. The 60 + 60 + 60 = 180 is the module practice allocation. Self-study audio and optional story duration are separate; this does not grant TESDA certification.

For 30 learners: ten triads, BHW/colleague/observer. Provide the bilingual A4 kit: option cards, version/cause sheet, safeguard checklist, proposal/retry record and one-page decision aid. Use dummy teaching sheets and kits only, with no patient records, medicines, clinical items or actual utility work. The kit supplies all fictional inputs; the trainer need not invent them.

## [prepare] Prepare before starting

Read the six paired screens and both original checks. Review local document-control, clinical single-use and facility procedures with an authorized reviewer before workplace transfer. Policy approval in the story remains unknown. Without an approved procedure, conduct discussion and dummy rehearsal only.

Print the kit, read the version A/B inputs and prepare roster T1–T10, learners A/B/C. Trainer sample: round 1 T1-A, round 2 T2-B, round 3 T3-C. Explain that the other 27 learners will not be trainer-observed in this run. Schedule their next observation opportunity; do not mark peer records as passed.

## [opening] Opening: 5 minutes

Say: “What waste could we reduce while preserving every protection?” Show the high-bill/vaccine-refrigerator card without switching equipment. Ask: “What must stay?” Expected: cold chain, required ventilation and handwashing water. Say: “We will make a proposal, not perform repairs or remove services.” Read the objective and original utilities check, or invite a learner to read.

## [steps] Modelling: 12 minutes

Minutes 0–4: compare utilities cards. Say: “Investigate unnecessary lights under procedure; do not switch off the refrigerator.” Model unknown authorization and savings.

Minutes 4–8: lay out drawer A, printout A, controlled master B and supervisor confirmation B. Ask: “What is confirmed? What remains unknown?” Record the version mismatch. Show two causes: drawer copied versus wrong file selected. Neither is proved; the person who printed has not answered. Verify the source before changing the routine.

Minutes 8–12: model the weaker “Reusable saves money.” Feedback: “What instructions remain? Which single-use reuse must be rejected?” Retry: “Only an approved teaching visual where suitable, with complete instructions; no clinical reuse. Policy approval is needed.” Show the proposal/retry record. Do not reveal the check ending before a response.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers and products

Safe proposal: ask an authorized person to inspect/repair the reported leak while preserving handwashing water, or investigate an approved teaching visual where suitable with complete accessible instructions. Rejection: handwashing restrictions or clinical single-use reuse. A high bill does not prove the refrigerator is the problem.

Verification product: drawer A; printout A; master B; simulated supervisor confirms B. The mismatch is confirmed. Whether the drawer or computer file caused it is unknown. Next: compare copies/files and ask the person who printed under procedure. No cost, measured savings, repair completion or actual approval is supplied.

Complete record: proposal selected; possible waste reduced; safeguard; rejected option and reason; authorization/verification needed; first attempt; specific feedback; observable retry; trainer-observation status.

## [misconception] Misconceptions and safe stopping

“Less paper even if wrong” → restore approved-version verification and complete instructions. “All plastics are reusable” → distinguish nonclinical teaching visuals from clinical single-use items. “Both A, so the drawer caused it” → consistent evidence is not proof. “High bill, stop the refrigerator” → protect the cold chain.

If actual shutdown, repair, clinical reuse or patient records are proposed, say: “Stop. Option cards only; we will preserve essential protection.” Stop the unsafe demonstration, explain the safeguard and repeat the dummy case. An invented cleaning recipe is not a correction. Ask the authorized facility/infection-prevention reviewer to review local procedure.

## [practice] Practice, feedback and retry: 25 minutes

Three six-minute rounds = 18 minutes, followed by seven minutes of shared debrief. Each round: 2 context/setup + 2 attempt + 1 feedback + 1 retry = 6. Round 1 A/B/C are BHW/colleague/observer; round 2 B/C/A; round 3 C/A/B.

Round 1: leak versus handwashing restriction. Round 2: approved reusable teaching visual versus clinical single-use reuse. Round 3: version/cause sheet and paper-saving proposal. Each attempt asks: “What do you choose? What protection stays? Why reject the other option? What is unknown?” Observer records exact actions/words, not impressions.

Feedback names one gap, such as “Authorization is missing.” Retry adds “Confirm with the supervisor first; this is still a proposal.” The trainer observes all four attempt/feedback/retry minutes for one sampled learner per round; the other two minutes allow setup/movement. Debrief compares unknowns; there is no attendance-based passing.

## [answer-key] Answer key for both checks

Utilities: index 0, first option. 1: investigate unnecessary lights under procedure while the refrigerator operates. 2: overnight refrigerator shutdown is unsafe. 3: required-ventilation shutdown is unsafe. Charlaine chooses safeguarded investigation, rejects both cuts and submits for an authorized decision. Approval and savings remain unknown.

Check: index 2, third option. 1: do not omit needed instructions. 2: do not use up old stock without approved-version verification. 3: check the approved version and an approved reusable visual where suitable with complete accessible instructions. Charlaine submits the safeguarded proposal; no measured savings, repair completion or observed competence is claimed.

Read every rationale after the response. Water, single-use rules, critical equipment, ventilation and urgent referral stay protected. Prompts and choices are exactly original; do not add fictional factual inputs to the quiz.

## [observe] Observation and debrief: 10 minutes

Trainer sample: T1-A round 1 minutes 2–6; T2-B round 2 minutes 8–12; T3-C round 3 minutes 14–18, relative to practice start. Only three complete four-minute observations; at least 27 learners remain not trainer-observed. Peer practice is not a pass.

Use the objective_index 0 indicator: safe choice, two-cause evidence checking, safeguard and rejection, verification before workplace action. Ready: without prompting. Needs practice: safe choice but incomplete explanation, followed by feedback and retry. Not yet: unsafe cut, followed by safe stop and supported retry. Record actual observed words/actions and support; do not turn this rubric into a certification rule.

Follow-up roster: T1-B/C, T2-A/C, T3-A/B and T4–T10 A/B/C = 27. Give each learner a separate four-minute observation slot plus setup/movement time; this cannot fit into the ten-minute debrief. Ask what evidence and protection must remain.

## [support] Support and transfer: 8 minutes

Read cards aloud, use large print and the learner’s chosen language. A colleague may record a spoken answer; the objective stays the same. Scaffold: “I choose __. __ stays. I reject __ because __. First verify __.” Remove prompts gradually on retry and record support.

Solo: write/say the same four lines, compare with the aid, correct and retry. No solo self-pass; schedule trainer observation. Transfer prompt: “On your next duty, which proposal and approved procedure will you check first?” Record the verifier and any follow-up that remains unconfirmed. No actual implementation without authorization.

## [sources-review] Sources and separate reviews

Candidate sources: Facilitator PDF 19/printed 12 (three-hour sustainable competency), PDF 22/printed 15 (different four-hour entrepreneurial competency), PDF 34/printed 27 (different ten-hour common competency); Manual PDF 14/printed 6 and PDF 30/printed 19; TESDA unit 400311217; WHO sustainability guidance. Manual and Guide list 7S in different orders; preserve quotations and do not invent one prescribed sequence.

The original 78-slide Day 1 deck has no separate sustainable-practices section; do not invent a slide citation. The fictional case and A/B sheets are adaptations, not source quotations. Consult the exact source-audit receipt for inspected originals and unresolved access. Sixty minutes of practice does not grant certification.

Separate states: source audit; facility/infection-prevention review; actual model audio review; human listening; owner package approval. Local reviewer, human listening and owner approval remain pending; model review does not replace them.
